ios.desc:
SnowHaze – the best privacy you can get on iOS. SnowHaze is a strong open-source browser that truly protects your data. Enjoy the internet without compromising your privacy and security. SnowHaze offers the most extensive tracking protection on iOS and many setting possibilities to adapt SnowHaze to your needs.

Become anonymous and protect all your devices using SnowHaze VPN. Your entire internet traffic will be encrypted and protected from man-in-the-middle attacks. Our Zero-Knowledge Auth technology uses random tokens to provide the first fully anonymous VPN; from registration, over payment, up to usage, every step is built with privacy by design.

You can protect your IP address and access location specific contents by changing your perceived location. Everything is subject to the most simple privacy policy possible: Nothing is saved, really nothing. Even we don't know who you are!

*****************************
40% off yearly subscriptions
*****************************

VPN:
-	Zero-Knowledge Auth technology
-	Anonymous
-	Usage on all your devices
-	VPN service on dedicated servers in 9 countries (Switzerland, USA, Canada, Germany, France, UK, Australia, Singapore, Poland)
-	OpenVPN and IPsec protocols
-	No logs
-	DNS leak protection
-	Hide your IP address and location
-	Access location specific contents
-	Perfect forward secrecy

BROWSER:
-	Open-source
-	Tor Network Integration
-	Ad blocker
-	JavaScript control
-	Allow scripts temporary and permanently
-	Per tab and per site settings
-	10 search engines including StartPage, Qwant, and DuckDuckGo
-	Automatic and forced HTTPS connections
-	Popover blocker
-	Control cache, cookies, HSTS and web data
-	Randomly changing user agents
-	Automatically delete history of private sites
-	Tracking blocker
-	HTTP referer blocker
-	Protection from canvas fingerprinting, audio context fingerprinting, session replay and many more
-	Passcode lock
-	Local data encryption
-	Privacy level calculation
-	Sandboxed tabs
-	Text search on page
-	QR and barcode scanner
-	Fast 365 day/year support

Subscription:
The yearly SnowHaze Premium subscription is valid for one year; the monthly SnowHaze Premium subscription is valid for one month. During this time, you have access to the SnowHaze VPN, the SnowHaze search engine and your lists are updated regularly. The payment is charged to your iTunes Account when confirming the purchase.
